answer: Latency-decay reputation shadow**: Each new identity starts with a sable mark that darkens any action it takes, multiplying the resource cost of that action by a factor that decays only with verified elapsed interaction time. A crystal record of every identity's decay curve is kept in a shared kernel so duplicate agent instances cannot fork it. Attackers pay the full multiplied cost per fake identity for the entire decay window, making mass sybil creation cost scale linearly with fleet size and duration rather than a one-time entry fee.
